periods.time: Morning after first round, before second round
periods.location: contestant hotel and Osaka Bay Dome
periods.summary: The tournament committee compresses the schedule, forcing second and third rounds into the same day after Stella's B-block sweep removes matches and triggers broadcast-rights fallout.
periods.cause: Tatara cannot continue, Rinna withdraws, and Hiraga is disqualified after Stella's special match, leaving Stella already in the semifinals and removing broadcasted B-block content for days in a year when Stella's international popularity inflated broadcast-rights bids enormously.
periods.process: Contestants receive a notice that B-block withdrawals and disqualification reduce match count, so the committee will finish both second and third rounds that day. Kagami explains that broadcasters and sponsors had paid far above normal because of Stella's presence and pressured the committee over lost match days; the committee refunds one day's worth and compresses the schedule. Ikki and Shizuku also suspect Amane's wish may have nudged circumstances to make Ikki suffer more.
periods.outcome: Ikki must potentially fight Byakuya and Sara on the same day despite his one-use-per-day trump-card limitations; Stella feels guilty but is reassured by Kagami and Ikki.
periods.aftermath: Ikki frames the earlier final date as good fortune because it brings his promised meeting with Stella closer, then heads to C-block second round.
periods.significance: Creates the volume's tactical pressure: Ikki's limited trump cards must be managed across multiple elite opponents in one day, possibly as Amane intended.
